bragg_radius_audit.archive_contents: DS1.zip, DS2.zip, DS3.zip, DS4.zip, DS6.zip, DS9.zip, DS10.zip, DS12.zip, DS13.zip, DS14.zip
bragg_radius_audit.interpretation_limit: The repeated −11.3° archive correction is not a per-scan measurement; the 191° paper calibration has no scan ID in the public Methods. Bragg radii suggest a modest scale difference for DS13/DS14, but are not an independent camera-length calibration and must not be used to infer a true orientation/frame rotation.

reader.radius_convention: Pinned DiskSet.set_com_central uses the mean of active x/y centers. DiskSet.d_set normalizes all distances by the smallest radius; determine_rings(tol=0.5) assigns first ring within 0.5 of ratio 1 and second ring within 0.5 of sqrt(3). The x-coordinate sign flip in d_set does not affect radii.
reader.unpickler: Only diskset.DiskSet is mapped to an inert holder; NumPy ndarray/dtype and NumPy multiarray _reconstruct/scalar globals are allowed. All other pickle globals are rejected.

width_comparison.primary_vs_alternate_definition: two_rotated_10 minus archive_13.2; rotated geometry is used for DS13/DS14 where present, while other maps use the archived nominal geometry.
width_comparison.qualification: Common section must qualify on measured widths and all four candidate/frame fits under both camera calibrations, using the shared geometry-probe qualified() helper.
width_comparison.score_definition: For each map and candidate, average over the two orders of abs(mean predicted width - mean measured width); all-map scores average the ten map scores equally.

spatial_resampling.draw_policy: Each map uses a common spatial block draw matrix for every candidate and both measured orders; one seeded RNG is consumed in requested_scans order.
